data.one_liner: Plugin to read and write Android content URIs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to resolve content URIs to a Content object and write data back to a content URI on Android. It handles platform-specific quirks such as non‑Dart Uri parsing.
use_when: Need to access files via Android content URIs (e.g., from intent data or app links).
Want to write data to a content URI that is writable by the target provider.
avoid_when: Targeting iOS, web, or other platforms; the plugin only works on Android.
strengths: Simple, single‑method API for resolving and writing content.
Handles edge cases like non‑Dart Uri parsing and Android 16‑KB page size support.
No build_runner or code generation required.
weaknesses: Android‑only; no support for other platforms.
Limited documentation on error handling and permissions.
No examples for complex use cases like batch writes.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and run flutter pub get. No additional native configuration required.
